name: Kelp DAO
description: Kelp DAO issues rsETH, a liquid restaking token: users deposit ETH or liquid-staking tokens that are restaked through EigenLayer and other restaking layers, and receive rsETH to use across DeFi. Kelp is part of the Kernel DAO ecosystem.
description_zh: Kelp DAO 发行流动性再质押代币 rsETH：用户存入 ETH 或流动性质押代币，这些资产通过 EigenLayer 等再质押层进行再质押，用户获得可在 DeFi 中使用的 rsETH。Kelp 属于 Kernel DAO 生态。
chains: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Linea, Scroll

geo_feature.scope: Gain vaults (growth, airdrop and stable vault pages): the app asks universe.kelpdao.xyz/rseth/geoData and sends a visitor with isRestricted:true to /blocked ('Not available in your region'). Restricted from the US, the UK and Canada in the 2026-10-12 test; open from 15 other countries; the full list is not published.

screening.provider: Users represent they are not sanctioned (OFAC, UN, EU, UK, HKMA, MAS); access may be blocked under the AML provisions

kyc.scope: Terms allow KYC/AML checks at the operator's discretion or when required by law.

tos.restricted: No named jurisdictions; sanctions-list representations only

notes: Closed frontend; deposits and withdrawals use public contracts. The Gain vault gate is decided by Kelp's geoData API.
live: universe.kelpdao.xyz/rseth/geoData (2026-10-12): US, US-NY, GB, CA, CA-ON -> isRestricted:true; RO DE FR NL UA TR AE SG JP AU BR HK KR -> false
evidence: kerneldao.com/kelp bundle: geoData request and the redirect of /gain/*-vault/ pages to /blocked
